# Phase Two — Execution Plan

1. Refresh repository status and checkpoint evidence.
2. Create a live feature matrix from real imports and tests.
3. Spawn specialist agents sequentially through the tunnel mission system; no parallel Chrome tabs.
4. Assign nonoverlapping audit scopes first.
5. Convert every proven defect into `DEFECT_LEDGER.md` and `REMAINING_WORK.md`.
6. Read complete target files, dependencies, consumers, and tests.
7. Rewrite complete files only.
8. Run focused verification for each defect.
9. Run render/export and exact scale courts.
10. Run full `npm run verify`.
11. Run compliance, syntax, line-count, tab, header, and `git diff --check` gates.
12. Re-read all changed files and close the delta.
